name: Summer Robin Girl
original_name: サマー・ロビン・ガール
source:
The Tanabata Summer Festival is held every year at a local shrine.
She was looking forward to the day the most in the year.
Because on that day, everything she wanted has been fulfilled.
What exactly does she think and what she wants this year?

A moving youth mystery, Summer Robin Girl!

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/399]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
每年七夕夏日祭都会在当地的神社举行。
这是她一年中最期待的一天。
因为在那一天，她想要的一切都已经实现了。
今年她到底有什么想法以及她想要什么？

动人的青春悬疑，夏知更鸟少女！

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/399]NovelGame[/url]]
